notes: These are production requirements only. Generated image art is a candidate until human visual review promotes it.
Do not mark temporary LPC stand-ins as resolved until both candidate sheets pass validation and the visual manifest is rewired.

current_stand_in.note: knight_sword_t01 currently uses the temporary dagger slash sheet. No walk-cycle sword sheet exists, so idle/walk show no blade.

requirements.description: Production longsword weapon-layer PNG sheets for Knight tier-1: one walk-cycle sheet and one slash sheet. Weapon layer only; no body, armor, or baked equipment combinations.

directions.note: Left and right are separate authored rows. Do not mirror left from right or right from left.

alignment.feet_line: existing LPC feet line; compositor draws the cell at (-32, -54) in character space and places feet at (48, 70) inside the 96x84 bake cache
alignment.sword_grip: per-frame grip must match the LPC hand position in the matching body sheet column for that animation group
alignment.renderer_pixel_offset: do not add a per-item pixel offset in the renderer

validation.manifest_rewire_gate: Do not rewire CHARACTER_VISUALS knight_sword_t01 away from the temporary dagger until both walk and slash candidate sheets pass human visual review.

sheets.content: Longsword weapon layer only, aligned to LPC walkcycle body hands across all 9 columns and 4 direction rows.
Longsword weapon layer only, aligned to LPC slash body hands across all 6 columns and 4 direction rows. Not the temporary dagger sheet.

out_of_scope: Do not generate artwork in this requirement file.
Do not change renderer or characterVisuals.js until both candidates are validated.
Do not start Berserker, Assassin, Ranger, Mage, or Priest sheets.
Do not treat slash192/WEAPON_longsword.png (192px grid) as a drop-in replacement.
